payload.core_mechanism_summary: Computes longest non-decreasing subsequence of species array using 1D DP over species IDs (values 1..m), each step updating p[j] = min(p[j], min(p[:j])) - 1 to track negative length.
payload.rationale: The code maintains a 1D array p (size m+1) where p[j] stores negative length of best LNDS ending with species j; it iterates through plants and updates p in O(m) per step. This is a classic 1D DP over values, not a 2D state DP.
